The '''Trade Federation Recruitment Center''' was a organization within the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] which existed in the final [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] the center had put out a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] engineer and criminal [[Onicrop K'Cin]] who they claimed had knowledge of Trade Federation encryption codes and expertise in forging false identities. They offered a reward 1500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for his capture alive and only half that if he was brought in [[Death/Legends|dead]]. The bounty was claimed in 32 BBY by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], who captured K'Cin alive on [[Outland Transit Station]], whilst Fett was there hunting the [[Muttani]] criminal [[Meeko Ghintee]]. The stations [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] owner [[Rozatta]] was the one who informed Fett of the center's bounty on K'Cin.<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Trade Federation Recruitment Center was fist mentioned in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' released by [[LucasArts]] in [[2002]]. The center was mentioned in the e-scanner bounty entry for Onicrop K'cin, a secondary bounty available during the second level of the first chapter.
